description: [Seller reputation: x402 seller risk check, verdict] Before an agent pays an x402 seller: score the seller Base wallet or endpoint 0-100 from public USDC history (buyers, wash share, age, concentration, 30-day volume). Returns verdict, components, reasons and a receipt (Ed25519-signed when signing is enabled; see /.well-known/gw8-receipt-key `enabled`). Deterministic; stateless; never pays anyone. Give address and/or endpoint. Paid: $0.01 USDC on Base, paid in-band via x402 MCP (@x402/mcp; _meta "x402/payment"). Also at POST https://micro-saas-agent.onrender.com/api/seller/reputation.
